title: Whose Morality Do They Speak? Unraveling Cultural Bias in Multilingual Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with the Moral Foundations Questionnaire-2 (MFQ-2) to measure alignment with WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) vs. non-WEIRD cultural norms, and comparing the model's moral judgments against human survey responses from different cultures.

Administering the MFQ-2 in eight different languages (Arabic, Farsi, English, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, French, and Russian) to determine whether models impose dominant, English-centric moral norms when prompted in other languages.
